title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Daily Rate Schedule
content:
**Finance office rate schedule — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The private-pay daily rate covers room, board and routine nursing. Rates are published by schedule, each keyed by the date it becomes effective.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**When a scheduled rate applies to one agreement.** A new scheduled rate needs 60 calendar days of written notice before it takes effect (the federal advance-notice rule for private-pay rate changes). For one agreement, the scheduled rate takes effect on the **later** of:
1. the schedule's effective date, and
2. the date the written rate notice was delivered for that agreement plus 60 calendar days.

The figure of 60 days applies to all six tiers.

**Illustration on the schedule effective 1 July 2026 (hypothetical delivery dates).**
- Notice delivered on 3 March 2026: 3 March plus 60 days is 2 May 2026, earlier than 1 July 2026, so the new rate takes effect for that agreement on 1 July 2026.
- Notice delivered on 25 May 2026: 25 May plus 60 days is 24 July 2026, later than 1 July 2026, so the new rate takes effect for that agreement on 24 July 2026.
